name: New York Times API
tagline: Access NYT article search, top stories, bestsellers, and archive data via REST
description: The New York Times Developer Network provides REST APIs for article search, top stories, most popular content, books bestsellers, movie reviews, and historical archives. Developers authenticate with an API key obtained through self-serve registration and can query current and archival news data in JSON.

auth.details: API key via api-key query parameter (or X-Api-Key header on some endpoints); self-serve signup at developer.nytimes.com

use_cases: search NYT articles by keyword and date range
get today's top stories by section
retrieve most popular articles by views or shares
look up movie reviews and critics picks
